title: State enforcement actions since 2021: what the dashboard shows
question: How many citations and penalties has the State health department issued since 2021, against which kinds of facilities, and how fast are they rising?
finding: From 1 January 2021 to 17 November 2026 the State issued 7,662 enforcement actions; 6,772 (88%) were long-term care citations and penalties. The largest dollar line is the nursing-hours penalty: 1,723 issued, $44.4 million initially assessed. Long-term care actions rose from 825 in 2021 to 1,417 in 2025, and long-term care penalty dollars from $7.4 million to $23.6 million.
how: Copied from the one-page dashboard printout the owner saved (Summary.pdf, data refreshed 17 November 2026, all filters set to All). The pairing of each label with its figure is read from the printed chart; every figure is checked by the script to appear in the file's text. Dollar figures are initial penalty amounts, before appeal or reduction, rounded by the dashboard to thousands.
limits: Statewide figures only: the printout has no county or facility breakdown, so it cannot say how many of these actions concern San Francisco homes. Facility-level State actions to June 2024 are already screened in the health_more group; the dashboard's facility download would extend them to November 2026. 2026 is a part year.
